evidence.title: YouArt launched today
evidence.excerpt: I'm thrilled to introduce YouArt – a groundbreaking creative AI Agentic-Workflow studio. link: YouArt.ai Why YouArt exists: We loved AI art tools but hated the randomness. Hours of regenerating, wasted credits, inconsistent results. We built YouArt to fix this. The Breakthrough: We started with a simple workflow editor for power users. The results were incredible, but the learning curve was steep. Then we had a breakthrough: What if an AI agent could build workflows for you?That's when YouArt…
